name: Future Scenario Planning
description: Strategic foresight template for exploring plausible futures, weak signals, strategic options, and no-regret moves.

sections.title: Focal Question
sections.instruction: State the future-oriented question, time horizon, domain, and strategic decision being informed

sections.title: Signals & Drivers
sections.instruction: List weak signals, trends, uncertainties, constraints, and forces shaping the future

sections.title: Scenario Narratives
sections.instruction: Summarize each future scenario, including assumptions, conditions, winners, losers, and surprises

sections.title: Implications
sections.instruction: Capture implications for customers, operations, technology, policy, partners, and competition

sections.title: Strategic Options
sections.instruction: List options the organization could pursue under one or more scenarios

sections.title: No-Regret Moves
sections.instruction: List actions that appear useful across multiple scenarios and can start soon

sections.title: Watchlist
sections.instruction: Define indicators to monitor that would suggest one scenario is becoming more likely
